settings.title: How long will the results of a face lift last?
settings.text:
Most of you are skeptical about the effectiveness of the microcurrent face lift, and it is truly beneficial for the amount of time it takes to show the results is very minimal but on the other
hand,  the duration for lasting results is cumulative. Regular and consistent facelift treatments can truly transform your skin while increasing collagen production. It is recommended to do a series to get the optimal results.

The frequency of therapy will decide how long the face lift will last. It is very important to follow a comprehensive skincare routine, using correct face tools, avoiding harsh sun exposure, and optimum water intake to maximize the quality of results after doing a series of microcurrent treatments.

settings.title: What face tools can help you enhance your transformation toward the non-surgical face lift?
settings.text:
Face tools are designed to complement your microcurrent therapy, they are that diligent assistant that can make a massive impact on your skincare routine if incorporated. These face tools come in various different sizes, shapes, and materials, each servicing a specific purpose.

Facial Rollers: Facial rollers made from jade and quartz, can significantly remove puffiness and promote lymphatic drainage. This is an essential face tool that can heavily assist microcurrent devices for face lifting. As the core of microcurrent therapy lies in its non-surgical face-lifting concept such face tools should be compulsorily added to your skincare routine.

Gua Sha tool: By gently scraping the skin, the gua sha face tool can reduce the tension between facial muscles and skin tone and enhance the results of a non-surgical facelift. 

Derma Rollers: Derma rollers a.k.a micro-needling face tool, create micro-injuries in the skin, stimulating collagen protection. Using this face tool in conjunction with a non-surgical facelift can enhance skin firmness and promote a more youthful appearance as well as assist in the healing of the skin.

LED light: By using a red LED light before using microcurrent you are warming up the muscles before you do a lift on the muscles.  Much like the gym, warm muscles respond better to lifting. 

By incorporating these face tools into your skincare routine alongside a non-surgical facelift, you can enhance the transformation process and achieve more noticeable and long-lasting results. However, it's essential to consult with a skincare professional before using any face tools to ensure they are suitable for your skin type and condition.

settings.title: Why is it the perfect substitute for a surgical face lift?
settings.text:
Face lift devices such as MyoLift™ have worked wonders in terms of effectively scaling microcurrent spas for estheticians and delivering exceptional results for customers.

There are no incisions, injections, or penetration of the skin. The skin's surface remains intact, minimizing the risk of infection and other complications associated with invasive procedures. You can see the pictures of microcurrent before and after images to get clarity over its effectiveness. 

No pain, only gain! 

This is the key attribute that sets apart a face lift from any other cosmetic procedure. This feature gives early adopters the confidence to try out microcurrent skincare. Nowadays, face lifting equipment is offering customized treatments for varied skin concerns of the products. It is the most comfortable and natural way to improve their facial aesthetics and there is no such thing as permanency of damage involved. 

Safety and comfort by using devices for face lifting 

Some of the devices for face lifting are FDA-approved for example - 7E Wellness. To eliminate risk,  certified devices for face lifting enhance customer experience by providing them a sense of relief and assurance of utmost safety.
